author: Samsung
description:
One night, a forgotten magic carpet dreamed of flying again.
By AI Motion Wind, a little bit of magic returned.
Powered by the magical 7 Motion Wings, a fantasy comes to life.
With Max Cooling, the carpet rises into the air in an instant, while AI Direct Wind follows precisely, guiding its flight wherever it goes.
And when the perfect temperature is finally reached, WindFree ™ gently settles in, offering comfortably cool rest without cold drafts.
Create a space filled with magical comfort with Bespoke AI WindFree Pro.
